[Trend Position]
· Current Price ($57.37) vs SMA5/20/50 ($57.29/$56.83/$56.09) — Above short-term and mid-term trends.
· Position relative to SMA100/200 ($55.85/$55.56) — Good long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (47.2%) + Historically mid-range price level.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (62.6→61.3) — Staying neutral, cooling from overbought.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-0.0073→0.0376) — Improving, bottoming signal.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Mid-band $56.83) — Consolidating near mid-band, 2.28% band width is normal.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($57.36) — Close to current price, based on Pivot Point (PP).
· Swing Resistance ($57.50) — Close to current price, potential for short-term upside on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern — Consolidation phase, no clear Higher Low or Lower High formed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.26x) — Low confidence in price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis — Accumulation phase, consider buying on break above $57.36 support and $57.50 resistance.

analysis.patternNoteEn: The daily chart shows no clear trend pattern, with price consolidating as there's no significant difference between the 5-day and 20-day highs/lows.
keyPoints: RSI가 60선 부근에서 횡보하며 방향성을 잃고 중립 구간을 유지하고 있다.
MACD 히스토그램은 개선되고 있으나 여전히 약세 수렴 상태로 추세 전환 동력이 부족하다.
거래량 비율이 0.26배로 위축되어 현재 가격 움직임의 신뢰도가 낮다.
keyPointsEn: RSI is consolidating near the 60 level, maintaining a neutral stance and losing directional momentum.
MACD histogram is improving but remains in weak convergence, lacking power for a trend reversal.
The volume ratio of 0.26x indicates low confidence in the current price movement.
analysis.riskNote: ADX 12.0으로 추세 미형성 구간이므로, 현재의 횡보 또는 작은 변동은 언제든 충격성 변동으로 이어질 수 있다.
